title: zesty crispy moroccan beef tomatoes pastilla
description: a vibrant and indulgent moroccan dish featuring crispy beef, tomatoes, and a tangy pickle kick, all wrapped in a flaky pastilla crust.
instructions: preheat oven to 220c. roll out puff pastry to 3mm thickness.
in a large pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. add beef strips and cook for 5 minutes.
add onion, spices and 1 tsp salt to the pan. stir-fry for 2 minutes.
stir in pickle relish and cook for 1 minute.
add tomatoes to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes.
stir in flour and cook for 1 minute.
roll out puff pastry to a large rectangle. place beef mixture in one half of the pastry, leaving a 5mm border.
brush the border with water and fold the other half over the filling.
press the edges together to seal the pastilla.
use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top crust.
place the pastilla on a baking sheet and brush with water.
bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
